title: The National Disability Insurance Scheme
log: 2026-11-01T14:46:38Z match: Claude Haiku 5.5 found no bank point the same, so it is written new

match.reason: The bank point covers Medicare, the PBS and private insurance, but not the NDIS, which funds support for people with permanent and significant disability and is a different idea from general health-care subsidies.

draft.title: The National Disability Insurance Scheme
card: The National Disability Insurance Scheme (NDIS) funds support for Australians with a permanent and significant disability.
Each participant has a plan based on their goals and needs. Funding can pay for supports such as therapy, equipment or help with daily tasks.
The aim is to help people live more independently and take part in the community, such as in study, work and social life.
The NDIS is not for all health problems. It is for disability that is permanent and has a significant effect on daily life.
draft.remember: The NDIS pays for supports that help people with a significant disability gain independence.

a.q: What is the main aim of the NDIS?
opts: To fund supports that help people live more independently
To pay for every medical cost for all Australians
To provide free private hospital cover to everyone
To replace Medicare for people with a disability
a.why: The NDIS funds supports for people with a permanent and significant disability so they can live more independently. It does not cover every medical cost, so it does not replace Medicare.
a.clue: Think about what supports are for.

b.q: Sam has a permanent and significant disability. Which would the NDIS be most likely to fund in his plan?
opts: Therapy to build skills for daily living
A short course of antibiotics for a chest infection
A private hospital room for planned surgery
A gym membership for general fitness
b.why: Plans fund supports linked to the person's disability, such as therapy that builds independence. Antibiotics for an infection are a general health need, which is covered through other schemes.
b.clue: Pick the support linked to the disability and independence.

a.best: To fund supports that help people live more independently

b.best: Therapy to build skills for daily living
